lesson.intro: Un condicional tiene dos partes: la clausula if (la condicion) y la clausula principal (el resultado). El tipo lo decide una pregunta: la condicion, es siempre cierta (cero), una posibilidad real futura (primero), una hipotesis del presente (segundo) o un pasado que ya no se puede cambiar (tercero)? Regla de oro: nunca will ni would dentro de la clausula if.

sections.heading: 1 - Zero conditional
sections.body:
if / when + presente simple, presente simple.

Para verdades generales, leyes de la naturaleza y relaciones causa-efecto que se cumplen siempre. Aqui if y when son intercambiables.
examples: If you heat ice, it melts.
When it gets dark, the lights come on.
Water boils if you heat it to 100 °C.
If you don't water plants, they die.

sections.heading: 2 - First conditional
sections.body:
if + presente simple, will / can / may / might + base (o imperativo).

Para situaciones reales y posibles en el futuro. En la clausula if nunca se pone will.
examples: If it rains, we'll stay in.
If you see her, tell her.
You might be late if you don't hurry.
If we leave now, we'll catch the early train.

sections.heading: 3 - Second conditional
sections.body:
if + pasado simple, would / could / might + base.

Para situaciones imaginarias, improbables o imposibles en el presente o el futuro. Con be se usa were para todas las personas: If I were you...
examples: If I won the lottery, I would travel.
If I were taller, I'd play basketball.
What would you do if you saw a bear?
They'd be happier if they lived in the countryside.

sections.heading: 4 - Third conditional
sections.body:
if + past perfect (had + participio), would have / could have / might have + participio.

Para el pasado que NO ocurrio: hipotesis y arrepentimientos sobre lo que ya paso.
examples: If I had known, I would have told you.
She would have passed if she had studied.
We wouldn't have got lost if we'd had a map.

sections.heading: 5 - unless, as long as, provided, in case, even if
sections.body:
• unless = if... not: Don't call unless it's urgent.
  • as long as / provided (that) = solo si: You can go as long as you're back by ten.
  • in case = por si acaso; el verbo va en presente: Take cash in case the card doesn't work.
  • even if = aunque / aun si: Even if it rains, we'll go.
examples: You'll fail unless you study.
I'll lend it to you as long as you return it tomorrow.
I'll write it down in case you forget.
Even if I had a million euros, I wouldn't buy that.

sections.heading: 6 - Orden de las clausulas y coma
sections.body:
Las dos clausulas se pueden intercambiar sin cambiar el sentido.

  • Si la clausula if va primera, se pone coma detras: If it rains, we'll stay.
  • Si va segunda, no hay coma: We'll stay if it rains.

El will / would va en la clausula principal, no en la de if. then puede abrir la principal (If..., then...).
examples: If you leave now, you'll make it.
You'll make it if you leave now. (sin coma)
If I were you, then I'd apologise.

sections.heading: 7 - Errores tipicos: will / would tras 'if'
sections.body:
• 1er condicional: no se pone will en la clausula if (If you help me, no "If you will help me").
  • 2o / 3er condicional: no se pone would en la clausula if (If I were / If I had known, no "If I would be / If I would have known").

Excepciones: If you will / would wait here... como peticion muy formal, o if con sentido de whether (I don't know if she will come).
examples: If it rains tomorrow, we'll cancel.
If I had more time, I would learn the guitar.
I would have called you if I had known.

sections.heading: 8 - Elegir el tipo de condicional
sections.body:
Cuatro preguntas rapidas:

  1. Es una verdad siempre cierta? → zero.
  2. Es una posibilidad real en el futuro? → first.
  3. Es imaginario o improbable ahora? → second.
  4. Es sobre el pasado que ya no se puede cambiar? → third.
examples: If you drop it, it breaks. (zero)
If it rains, we'll stay. (first)
If I had time, I'd help. (second)
If I'd known, I'd have come. (third)

contrast.title: Los cuatro condicionales
rows: If I'd known, I'd have come.

mistakes: NO: If it will rain, we'll stay. -> SI: If it rains, we'll stay.
NO: If I would be you, I'd rest. -> SI: If I were you, I'd rest.
NO: If I would have known, I would have come. -> SI: If I had known, I would have come.
NO: If I had a car, I will drive you. -> SI: If I had a car, I would drive you.
NO: Unless you don't hurry, you'll be late. -> SI: Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
NO: She would have called if she knew. -> SI: ... if she had known.
NO: If you leave now you'll make it. -> SI: If you leave now, you'll make it.

Test-English - Zero, first and second conditional (B1)

questions.prompt: If you heat ice, it ___.
Plants die if they ___ enough water.
questions.explanation: Zero conditional: presente simple en las dos clausulas.

questions.prompt: When the sun ___, it gets warm.
If I ___ tired, I go to bed early.
questions.explanation: Rutina con causa-efecto -> zero: presente + presente.

questions.prompt: El zero conditional sirve para:
questions.explanation: Leyes de la naturaleza, rutinas siempre ciertas.

questions.prompt: Water ___ if you cool it to 0 C.
If you press this button, the machine ___.
Completa: If you mix blue and yellow, you ___ (get) green.
En el zero conditional, 'if' se puede sustituir por:
My dog barks if someone ___ at the door.
If metal ___ hot, it expands.
Las dos clausulas del zero conditional van en:
If it rains tomorrow, we ___ inside.
questions.explanation: First conditional: if + presente, will + base.

questions.prompt: I'll call you if I ___ time.
questions.explanation: En la clausula 'if', presente simple (no will).

questions.prompt: If you don't hurry, you ___ the bus.
She ___ be angry if she finds out.
questions.explanation: En la principal caben will / may / might / can.

questions.prompt: If you see John, ___ him to call me.
Completa: If we leave now, we ___ (catch) the early train.
El first conditional habla de:
options: situaciones reales y posibles en el futuro
questions.answer: situaciones reales y posibles en el futuro
questions.explanation: Condiciones que pueden cumplirse de verdad.

questions.prompt: I won't go if you ___ come with me.
questions.explanation: Clausula 'if' -> presente simple, tambien en negativa.

questions.prompt: If the weather ___ good, we'll have a picnic.
If I ___ promoted, I'll buy a car.
questions.explanation: if + presente simple (aunque el sentido sea futuro).

questions.prompt: You can borrow my car if you ___ careful.
questions.explanation: Clausula 'if' -> presente simple; 'can' en la principal.

questions.prompt: Unless it stops raining, we ___ at home.
questions.explanation: 'unless' funciona como 'if... not' en un 1er condicional.

questions.prompt: If he ___ hard, he'll pass.
If I ___ rich, I would travel the world.
questions.explanation: Second conditional: if + pasado simple; con 'be' -> were.

questions.prompt: If I won the lottery, I ___ a house.
If I ___ you, I wouldn't do that.
questions.explanation: 'If I were you' es la forma fija para dar consejo.

questions.prompt: She ___ help if she had time.
questions.explanation: Clausula principal del 2o condicional -> would + base.

questions.prompt: If we lived nearer, we ___ visit more often.
El second conditional es para:
questions.explanation: Hipotesis que no son reales ahora.

questions.prompt: Completa: If I ___ (have) more money, I would buy it.
What would you do if you ___ a ghost?
If he studied more, he ___ better grades.
En el second conditional, la clausula 'if' usa:
questions.explanation: if + pasado simple (aunque no hable del pasado).

questions.prompt: I wouldn't say that if I ___ you.
If it ___ so expensive, I'd buy one.
They'd be happier if they ___ in the countryside.
If I had known, I ___ you.
If she ___ harder, she would have passed.
We ___ the train if we hadn't left late.
questions.explanation: Resultado pasado irreal -> would have + participio.

questions.prompt: El third conditional habla de:
questions.explanation: Hipotesis y arrepentimientos sobre el pasado.

questions.prompt: Completa: If you ___ (ask) me, I would have helped.
If it hadn't rained, the match ___.
En el third conditional, la clausula 'if' usa:
He wouldn't have got lost if he ___ a map.
I ___ come if you had invited me.
If they had left earlier, they ___ stuck in traffic.
'If only I had listened' expresa:
questions.explanation: Estructura de lamento ligada al 3er condicional.

questions.prompt: She would have called if she ___ your number.
La clausula principal del third conditional usa:
'unless' significa mas o menos:
questions.explanation: unless = a menos que / si no.

questions.prompt: You'll fail ___ you study.
questions.explanation: unless you study = if you don't study.

questions.prompt: I'll lend it to you ___ you return it tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 'as long as' = solo si / siempre que.

questions.prompt: Take an umbrella ___ it rains.
You can go out ___ you're home by ten.
questions.explanation: 'provided that' = con la condicion de que.

questions.prompt: ___ I had a million euros, I wouldn't buy that.
We won't get there on time ___ we leave now.
questions.explanation: unless we leave = if we don't leave.

questions.prompt: Tras 'in case', el verbo suele ir en:
questions.explanation: 'in case it rains', no 'in case it will rain'.

questions.prompt: You can borrow the car ___ you don't drive too fast.
questions.explanation: 'as long as' introduce la condicion que hay que cumplir.

questions.prompt: Equivale a 'You'll be fine if you don't panic':
options: You'll be fine unless you panic.
You'll be fine as long as you panic.
You'll be fine in case you panic.
questions.answer: You'll be fine unless you panic.

questions.prompt: I'll write down the address ___ you forget it.
Don't call me ___ it's an emergency.
questions.explanation: unless it's an emergency = if it isn't an emergency.

questions.prompt: Cuando la clausula 'if' va primera, se pone:
Cual esta bien puntuada?
options: If you leave now, you'll make it.
If you leave now you'll make it,
If, you leave now you'll make it.
questions.answer: If you leave now, you'll make it.

questions.prompt: 'We'll help you if you ask.' - Hace falta coma?
options: No, porque la clausula 'if' va en segundo lugar.
questions.answer: No, porque la clausula 'if' va en segundo lugar.
questions.explanation: Sin coma cuando 'if' va al final.

questions.prompt: El orden de las dos clausulas del condicional:
options: se puede cambiar sin alterar el significado
questions.answer: se puede cambiar sin alterar el significado

questions.prompt: En 'If I were you, I'd rest', 'I'd' es:
Ordena: 'rains / if / it / we'll stay in'.
options: If it rains, we'll stay in.
If rains it, we'll stay in.
We'll stay in, if it rains.
questions.answer: If it rains, we'll stay in.
questions.explanation: if + sujeto + verbo; coma antes de la principal.

questions.prompt: 'would' / 'will' van en:
options: la clausula principal, no en la de 'if'
questions.answer: la clausula principal, no en la de 'if'

questions.prompt: Cual es correcta?
options: I would go if I had time.
I would go if I would have time.
I will go if I would have time.
questions.answer: I would go if I had time.
questions.explanation: 2o condicional: would en la principal, pasado simple tras 'if'.

questions.prompt: 'Had I known, I would have come' es:
options: una inversion formal del 3er condicional (= If I had known...)
questions.answer: una inversion formal del 3er condicional (= If I had known...)
questions.explanation: Registro formal: se omite 'if' e invierte had + sujeto.

questions.prompt: Por escrito, 'If she calls I'll tell her' se escribe mejor:
options: If she calls, I'll tell her.
If she calls I'll tell her.
If, she calls, I'll tell her.
questions.answer: If she calls, I'll tell her.

questions.prompt: La palabra 'then' puede introducir:
Cual NO necesita coma?
options: I'd travel more if I had the money.
If I had the money I'd travel more.
If I had the money, I'd travel more.
questions.answer: I'd travel more if I had the money.
questions.explanation: Sin coma cuando la clausula 'if' va al final.

questions.prompt: Correcto: 'If it ___ tomorrow, we'll cancel.'
Correcto: 'If I ___ more time, I would learn the guitar.'
Patron incorrecto: 'If you will help me, ...'. La correccion:
questions.explanation: Nada de will en la clausula 'if'.

questions.prompt: 'If I would be rich...' deberia ser:
Clausula principal del 2o condicional: 'I ___ happier.'
Clausula 'if' del 3er condicional: 'If they ___ earlier...'
Cual es correcta?
options: If she asked me, I would say yes.
If she would ask me, I would say yes.
If she asks me, I would say yes.
questions.answer: If she asked me, I would say yes.

questions.prompt: 'will' tras 'if' solo se acepta cuando:
options: es una peticion educada ('If you will wait here...') o 'if' significa 'whether'
questions.answer: es una peticion educada ('If you will wait here...') o 'if' significa 'whether'
questions.explanation: Son los dos usos legitimos de 'if ... will'.

questions.prompt: Corrige: 'I would have called you if I would have known.'
questions.explanation: 3er condicional: if + past perfect, sin 'would have'.

questions.prompt: First conditional correcto:
options: If we hurry, we'll be on time.
If we will hurry, we'll be on time.
If we hurry, we be on time.
questions.answer: If we hurry, we'll be on time.

questions.prompt: En 'If I ___ you, I'd apologise', usa:
questions.explanation: 'If I were you' es la forma correcta.

questions.prompt: 'If he had listened, he would ___ the mistake.' Completa:
If you ___ water to 100 C, it boils. (verdad general)
If I ___ you tomorrow, I'll give you the book. (probable)
questions.explanation: Posibilidad real futura -> first conditional (if + presente).

questions.prompt: If I ___ a bird, I would fly south. (imposible)
questions.explanation: Hipotesis irreal del presente -> second conditional.

questions.prompt: If we ___ booked, we would have had seats. (pasado)
questions.explanation: Pasado irreal -> third conditional (if + past perfect).

questions.prompt: I'll be surprised if she ___ on time. (realista)
If humans ___ wings, air travel would be different. (hipotesis)
If you don't water plants, they ___. (hecho)
If I ___ known you were coming, I'd have baked a cake. (pasado)
If she ___ the offer, she'd regret it. (hipotesis presente)
We'll miss the start if the train ___ late. (probable)
If it ___ so cold yesterday, we would have gone out. (pasado)
If you ___ me earlier, I could have helped. (pasado)
Hipotesis del presente + would -> que condicional?
questions.explanation: if + pasado simple, would + base = second conditional.
